rules.title: Expo tooling
rules.text: Use Expo tooling and config plugins instead of editing native projects by hand.

rules.title: Virtualized lists
rules.text: Use FlatList or FlashList for long lists, never map inside ScrollView.

rules.title: Test on both platforms
rules.text: Verify changes on both iOS and Android and keep platform branches small.

rules.title: Safe areas
rules.text: Handle safe areas with react-native-safe-area-context, which replaces the core SafeAreaView, and handle keyboard avoidance on every screen.

rules.title: Measure on devices
rules.text: Profile on real devices and avoid inline functions and styles in hot lists.

rules.title: Typed navigation
rules.text: Type navigation params and keep screens decoupled through the navigator.

rules.title: Secure storage
rules.text: Store tokens in secure storage, not AsyncStorage.

rules.title: Respect native versions
rules.text: Check library compatibility with the React Native and Expo SDK version before upgrading.
